statement: For fixed C,M, let X=x^(3/2),m=floor X,Y=m^(3/2),1/2<=|t|<=CP^(1/24), even 0<=e_j<=CP^(1/24),1<=r_j<=CP^(1/24), and real |a_j|r_j<=CP^(1/2), with at most M terms. On a coarse partition of local count C(1+L P^(-11/24)), a_j are constant, phi is real C^3 with |phi'''|<=CP^(-13/12), and eta has sup norm plus variation <=C per cell. The odd-integer dyadic sum of eta e(tY+sum a_j Delta_(2r_j)Y(n+e_j)-sum sigma_l c_l A_l+phi) is O_(C,M,epsilon)(P^(31/32+epsilon)), with at most M translated D2 factors from Section 1 of the source, sigma_l in {-1,0,1}, and k_l,h_l,i<=CP^(1/24). D2 labels must stay fixed on their original gap runs; the coarse partition only refines them. The A-process H=P^(1/12) controls all but a fixed number of shifts by nonzero main curvature; D1 replacement, D2 error, all carry modes, and every partition endpoint are included. This is a family estimate, not a complete kernel theorem or OOOEE count. AI-assisted written proof with exact controls; no independent review or Lean verification.

Let X=x^(3/2),m=floor X,Y=m^(3/2),1<=h<=P^(1/12),1<=r<=CP^(1/24), and |a|r<=CP^(1/2). On an actual fixed carry branch Delta_(2h)Delta_(2r)Y=F_j(m), where beta_1~h sqrt(P),beta_2~r sqrt(P),|j|<=2. With offsets frozen, |F_j'| is O(|j|P^(-3/4)+hrP^(-5/4)). Replacing F_j(m) by F_j(X) in e(aF_j(m)) costs O_C(P^(3/4)) over the whole dyadic interval, including a fixed number of terms. The retained phase curvature is O_C(P^(-3/4)/r+hP^(-5/4)). No derivative of moving beta approximations or growing Fourier expansion of this floor error is needed. AI-assisted written proof with exact controls, not independently reviewed or Lean verified.
